timeline.text: My son looked at his study card and said, 'I see no change' — every subject was the same wall of text.
A big question, a big answer, a rule underneath — nothing worth looking at.
I rebuilt it in React to draw a real diagram from that same data.
Compound words split apart now, math steps get their own layout, grammar rules sit in a fixed footer.
The card now draws through thirty templates across six diagram styles.
